7731|0d7f0fc2.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|0d7f0fc2.text: We don't have much in the way of story or history of the Wetlands Excavation Site, but we do know that a mining crew of perilous arrogance attempted to blast a passage into the southern mountains overlooking Dun Morogh. A marshland that was forgotten was in the shadow of a lost titan watcher. Many have been sent in an attempt to discover the fate of the lost miners.

7731|40a0c440.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|40a0c440.text: The kingdom of Dalaran can be found west of the Alterac Mountains. Find the Hillsbrad Fields and travel north; you're sure to see the looming spires of the Kirin Tor.

7731|713c1eb7.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|713c1eb7.text:
The once flourishing and proud kingdom of Dalaran was met with ill fate when the Burning Legion came. The mighty Kirin Tor had no pause in returning the city of mages to its former glory. Its looming spires cast a shadow on even the tallest mountain in Alterac. 

The arcane ward that shielded the city and its inhabitants has fulfilled its purpose and while the city has yet to open its borders to all allies, it is extending a welcoming hand to all those willing to help see its majesty blossom once more.

7731|f331e69a.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|f331e69a.text: The entrance to Whelgar's Excavation Site can be found in the southern valley of the Wetlands. A cave along the western mountain ridge marks the passage.

6282-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-accept.text:
Tauren take pride as the protectors of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.

The Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.

I need you to cull the harpies, $N!
6282-accept.title: Harpies Threaten
